Not necessarily! According to our policy, if we sent you the **wrong live plant**, you can **keep it at no charge**—you don't have to send it back.

We'll ship the correct plant to you free by Express (where your zone allows) and email you a free return label for the wrong one, but returning it is optional.

Please report this within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the item and box so we can get the correct plant out to you right away. Have you already reported it, or would you like help starting that claim?
